title: SAMRefiner: Taming Segment Anything Model for Universal Mask Refinement
mechanism: Training-free refinement: mines distance-guided points, context-aware elastic boxes and Gaussian-style mask prompts from a coarse mask and feeds SAM; SAMRefiner++ adds a label-free IoU adaptation step.
adaptation: Zero-training test on predicted inactive regions (blobby, well labelled) and on BMRK cells; replicate EL to 3 channels; skip crack lines, which suit SAM poorly at 1-2 px.
min_experiment: Arm: SAMRefiner on house / PF inactive components. Baseline: unrefined masks. Metric: inactive IoU on 5-fold CV and E1 (PF). Kill: < +0.01 inactive IoU or any BMRK drop.
evidence: R: improves coarse masks from several sources for use as training labels across benchmarks (numbers not read).
prior_overlap: Frozen SAM2 Hiera-T linear probe showed no gain (BRIEF section 5); prompt-based mask refinement was not tested.

alt_notes.adaptation: Poor fit for 1 to 2 px cracks (the 2026 fracture paper found unconstrained MedSAM supervision hurts thin structures). Test only on region classes: inactive, material, edge_dark, splice, where boundaries are blobby.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house trained with SAMRefiner-refined masks for material, edge_dark, splice only, 3 seeds. Baseline: house. Metric: per-class IoU and mIoU_rob. Kill: mIoU_rob under +0.01.

alt_notes.adaptation: Not for cracks (SAM cannot resolve 1 to 2 px lines; frozen SAM2 probe gave no signal). Refine train labels of blob classes: inactive at BMRK (IoU 0.324), material, edge_dark; keep original where SAM IoU score is low.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house trained with SAM-refined inactive/material/edge_dark labels; baseline: house. Metrics: inactive IoU (clean-49 and E1), mIoU_rob. Kill if inactive and mIoU_rob both n.d.

alt_notes.adaptation: Blobby classes only: inactive, material, edge_dark, border; EL replicated to 3 channels; one prompt set per connected component of the house ensemble; IoU adaptation on the unlabelled 11.9k pool. Not for 1 to 2 px cracks. Also usable as a label-refinement tool (D16).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: SAMRefiner on ensemble inactive / material components. Baseline: house ensemble (PF ensemble on E1). Metrics: inactive IoU on OOF CV and E1, material and edge_dark IoU. Kill: inactive IoU < +0.02 on OOF CV.
